_comment: Which layer-A fixtures the Rust engine renders. Every fixture must appear here or in gaps; layerA/native-ready.unit.ts enforces that, so a new fixture cannot be silently skipped.

gaps.implicit-dollar-call: calls a JS-only fn (transform$) with no native$ declaration — unimplementable natively, as the census records
gaps.imported-callback: passes an imported JS function value as a callback; nothing native to call without a native$ declaration
gaps.plugin-callback: its compute() has no native$ declaration; the fixture covers the JS side of callback wire forms
gaps.global-call-setup: qwik:global.* ops have no receiver; the generator routes qwik: ops through qwik_ssr_std::call, which needs one
